title: The passive with se: how the empire was organised

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know the passive with *se* from B1 Unit 6 (*se busca una persona*, *se buscan personas*): you leave out who does the action and the verb agrees with the thing. It is the natural way to say what the crown created and where decisions were taken, because the doer is an institution or the king.

sections.title: The verb agrees with the noun
rows: Se creó el virreinato de Nueva España.
Se tomaban las decisiones en el Consejo de Indias.

items.spanish: En 1535 se creó el virreinato de Nueva España.
items.english: In 1535 the viceroyalty of New Spain was created.

items.spanish: En el siglo XVIII se crearon dos virreinatos nuevos.
items.english: In the 18th century two new viceroyalties were created.

items.spanish: En el Consejo de Indias se tomaban las decisiones más importantes.
items.english: The most important decisions were taken in the Council of the Indies.

items.spanish: En los cabildos se discutían los problemas locales.
items.english: Local problems were discussed in the town councils.

sections.content: Put the verb in the same number as the thing: *se creó un virreinato*, *se crearon dos virreinatos*. Use *se* when the doer is the crown or an institution and does not need a name; to name the doer, use *ser* + participle from B1 Unit 18.
